evaluation.results_summary: The developer reports high, though not perfect, coherence, and notes that safety remains strong because the model is built on an Instruct base, while narrative content is less constrained by positivity.
evaluation.safety_evals: The developer states that inherent safety remains strong due to the Instruct base, but narratives are less bounded by positivity.

links.citation: The developer appreciates a metadata link back to this model when it is used.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: The card reports only 'high, though not perfect, coherence' for a text-generation model, so factually inaccurate or untruthful outputs are a plausible risk.

possible_risks.description: In AI-assisted decision-making tasks, reliance measures how much a person trusts (and potentially acts on) a model's output. Over-reliance occurs when a person puts too much trust in a model, accepting a model's output when the model's output is likely incorrect. Under-reliance is the opposite, where the person doesn't trust the model but should.
possible_risks.justification: The card reports high but not perfect coherence and says narrative content is less constrained by positivity, so users may over-trust outputs in narrative or general text-generation contexts.

possible_risks.description: A metric selected to measure or track a risk is incorrectly selected, incompletely measuring the risk, or measuring the wrong risk for the given context.
possible_risks.justification: The card's safety evaluation is limited to a developer statement that safety remains strong due to the Instruct base, without reporting a metric that measures the stated less-constrained narrative content.

specifications.model_size: 17.2 GiB of safetensors weights (18,483,466,368 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: This model is a merge of grimjim/Kitsunebi-v1-Gemma2-8k-9B and anthracite-org/magnum-v3-9b-customgemma2, created using the SLERP merge method. The Magnum model was infused at a low weight of 0.2 to add variety to text generation.
